required_checks: Retain historical issuer identity, CUSIP/CIK evidence and unresolved retired/reorganization/ADR gaps; never silently map historical ticker to current unrelated issuer.

Preserve taxonomy/tag/unit/form/fiscal context/start/end/duration with accession; earliest per period/unit alone is insufficient to compare different accounting concepts or quarterly versus cumulative values.
An accession in companyfacts identifies a filing; crosschecking one NVDA document does not authenticate every other issuer-original value.
Date-only filings use explicit conservative next-trading-session assumption, distinguish from authenticated publication timestamp.
Preserve signed losses and unknown weight; do not infer EP, earnings growth or feature eligibility from raw fact counts.
Actual TTM, shares/ADR/splits and prices must share a verified unit basis before later feature qualification.
next_gate: Source inventory review then a separately frozen basket feature qualification design; no market outcomes or model fitting in this intake.
